verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an official SDK is a Tap to Phone SDK page (docs-33), which covers only device-based contactless payments. There is no evidence of general-purpose API client libraries; the OpenAPI spec is a building block, not an SDK, and the probe found no hosted spec file. Missing for 10: official server-side API client SDKs in multiple languages, documented SDK installation and usage guides, SDK coverage of core payin/onboarding/merchant APIs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Tap to Phone enables merchants to accept contactless payments directly on a compatible device.
